Name: Froth Images generated by Magotteaux Cell
Summary: 2250 froth images from a laboratory flotation cell in 45 categories of testing conditions, with a catalog of operating conditions and perceived froth quality.
Description:
This image database shows flotation froth produced in a special laboratory cell that emulates the conditions of an industrial flotation cell. Carlos Yantén and Willy Kracht published it on Figshare in 2023, with funding from Chile's Agencia Nacional de Investigación y Desarrollo under grant PIA AFB180004.

The 2250 images fall into 45 categories, and each category corresponds to one combination of testing conditions. A spreadsheet, ImagesCatalog.xlsx, gives the flotation operating conditions behind each category together with the visual properties seen in its images, such as the perceived quality of the froth.

The data are tagged for froth characterization and quality control in mineral processing and are released under CC BY 4.0.
